name: Logo Carousel
author: wpbranddigital

sections.description:
The WBD Logo Carousel block is a powerful and flexible solution for displaying multiple brand logos in an attractive, animated carousel format. Perfect for showcasing partners, clients, sponsors, or any collection of brand images on your WordPress site.

Key Features:

  • 2 Stunning Templates: Choose from Classic or Elegant designs
  • Customizable Logo Size: Adjust logo dimensions from 50px to 300px
  • Optional Alt Text Display: Show descriptive text below each logo
  • Smooth Auto-Scroll: Continuous, seamless carousel animation
  • Fully Responsive: Looks great on all devices and screen sizes
  • Easy Customization: Upload your logos and select your preferred template
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance with smooth animations
  • Grayscale Effect: Optional hover effect that colorizes logos on interaction

Available Templates:

  1. Classic – Clean, minimal design with subtle borders and gentle hover effects
  2. Elegant – Sophisticated card-style layout with soft shadows and refined aesthetics

Usage

  1. Add the Logo Carousel block to your page
  2. Click “Add Logo” to upload your brand images
  3. Add alt text for each logo for better accessibility
  4. Select your preferred template from the Template Style dropdown
  5. Adjust the logo size using the Logo Size slider
  6. Enable “Show Alt Text” if you want to display text below logos
  7. Optionally adjust the animation duration
  8. Add links to logos if desired
  9. Publish and enjoy your beautiful logo carousel!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wbd-logo-carousel directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Add the Logo Carousel block to any post or page using the block editor
  4. Upload your logo images and select your preferred template style
  5. Customize logo size and enable alt text display if desired
sections.faq:
How many logos can I add?

You can add as many logos as you need. The carousel will automatically adjust and create a smooth scrolling experience.

Can I customize the logo size?

Yes, you can adjust the logo size from 50px to 300px using the Logo Size control in the block settings.

Can I show alt text below the logos?

Yes, enable the “Show Alt Text” toggle in the block settings to display alt text below each logo.

Can I customize the animation speed?

Yes, you can adjust the animation duration through the block settings in the editor sidebar.

Are the logos clickable?

Yes, each logo can be linked to a custom URL, perfect for directing visitors to partner websites.

Will this work with my theme?

Absolutely! The Logo Carousel block is designed to work seamlessly with any WordPress theme.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, the carousel is fully responsive and optimized for all device sizes.
